name: HEDONITES OF SLAANESH: LORD OF HYSTERIA
description:
Lords of Hysteria are champions devoted to the Sacred Seduction of Paramountcy. Obsessed with being known as the greatest and grossest of revellers, they have sold their souls to powerful pleasure-daemons in exchange for both physical prowess and – more dangerously – the ability to plunge otherwise reasoning souls into fits of violence.

A Slaughterous Celebrant

This multipart plastic kit builds a Lord of Hysteria, a powerful leader for your Hedonites of Slaanesh armies in Warhammer Age of Sigmar. They are skilled warriors, well deserving of a place in the front lines, and they are capable of inspiring nearby allies to fight much harder to impress their demanding god. This reveller can be armed with either a long, mirrored blade or a censer flail. You'll find two helmet toppers, and one of the build options includes a large back decoration.

Contents:
– 17 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 40mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
